vllm-pr-58454.notes: "[Bugfix][GLM-5.3-Flash] kpool corruption with speculative decoding" by mmastrac (open when ported), building on vllm-project/vllm#55219 by ivanium. The TP4 profile serves a port of its kpool tail ring (index_kpool x cdiv(index_kpool + K, index_kpool) slots per request, the kernels addressing pos % ring) as Morrowmake/vllm-cmp170hx ported it in commit 1d4b59e, without that port's kill switch.

morrowmake-vllm-cmp170hx.notes: A vLLM fork whose commit 1d4b59e ports vllm-project/vllm#58454; the TP4 profile's kpool tail ring follows that port (Morrowmake/glm53-flash-cmp170hx-recipe, MIT, pins the fork).

vllm-pr-50843.notes: By alexbi29 (open when ported): the tile argmax of the gumbel, greedy-statistics and resampling kernels clamped to vocab_size - 1, so a row with NaN in its last tile cannot yield an out-of-vocabulary id.
